ValueSet.Description: The type of achievement. Extensible vocabulary: the fixed tokens below, or a string matching the pattern (ext:)[a-zA-Z0-9\.\-_]+.
ValueSet.Name: AchievementTypeEnum

Values.Description: Visual symbol containing verifiable claims in accordance with the Open Badges specification and delivered digitally. This is an exact match of Badge in [CTDL-TERMS].

Direct, indirect, formative, and summative evaluation or estimation of the nature, ability, or quality of an entity, performance, or outcome of an action. This is an exact match of Assessment in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents an award.
Credential that designates requisite knowledge and skills of an occupation, profession, or academic program. This is an exact match of Certificate in [CTDL-TERMS].

Credential assuring that an organization, program, or awarded credential meets prescribed requirements and may include development and administration of qualifying examinations. This is an exact match of QualityAssuranceCredential in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents a generic achievement.

Time-limited, revocable, renewable credential awarded by an authoritative body for demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform specific tasks or an occupation. Certifications can typically be revoked if not renewed, for a violation of a code of ethics (if applicable) or proven incompetence after due process. Description of revocation criteria for a specific Certification should be defined using Revocation Profile. This is an exact match of Certification in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents a course completion.
Represents community service.
Measurable or observable knowledge, skill, or ability necessary to successful performance of a person. This is an exact match of Competency in [CTDL-ASN-TERMS].
Represents a co-curricular activity.
Academic credential conferred upon completion of a program or course of study, typically over multiple years at a college or university. This is an exact match of Degree in [CTDL-TERMS].
Credential awarded by educational institutions for successful completion of a course of study or its equivalent. This is an exact match of Diploma in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents practical activities that are done away school, college, or place of work. Includes internships and practicums.

Credential awarded by a government agency or other authorized organization that constitutes legal authority to do a specific job and/or utilize a specific item, system or infrastructure and are typically earned through some combination of degree or certificate attainment, certifications, assessments, work experience, and/or fees, and are time-limited and must be renewed periodically. This is an exact match of License in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents membership.

Credential earned through work-based learning and earn-and-learn models that meet standards and are applicable to industry trades and professions. This is an exact match of ApprenticeshipCertificate in [CTDL-TERMS].
Represents the result of a curricular, or co-curricular assignment or exam.

College/university award for students typically completing the first one to two years of post secondary school education. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 5. This is an exact match of AssociateDegree in [CTDL-TERMS].

College/university award for students typically completing three to five years of education where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the first one to two years of college/university study. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 6. Use for 5-year cooperative (work-study) programs. A cooperative plan provides for alternate class attendance and employment in business, industry, or government; thus, it allows students to combine actual work experience with their college studies. Also includes bachelor's degrees in which the normal 4 years of work are completed in 3 years. This is an exact match of BachelorDegree in [CTDL-TERMS].

Credential that acknowledges completion of an assignment, training or other activity. A record of the activity may or may not exist, and the credential may or may not be designed as preparation for another resource such as a credential, assessment, or learning opportunity. This is an exact match of CertificateOfCompletion in [CTDL-TERMS].

Highest credential award for students who have completed both a bachelor's degree and a master's degree or their equivalent as well as independent research and/or a significant project or paper. Equivalent to UNESCO ISCED, Level 8. This is an exact match of DoctoralDegree in [CTDL-TERMS].

(GED) Credential awarded by examination that demonstrates that an individual has acquired secondary school-level academic skills. Equivalent to a secondary school diploma, based on passing a state- or province-selected examination such as GED, HiSET, or TASC; or to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011 Levels 2 or 3. This is an exact match of GeneralEducationDevelopment in [CTDL-TERMS].
Credential awarded to skilled workers on successful completion of an apprenticeship in industry trades and professions. This is an exact match of JourneymanCertificate in [CTDL-TERMS].
Set of learning opportunities that leads to an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate. This is an exact match of LearningProgram in [CTDL-TERMS].

Doctoral degree conferred upon completion of a program providing the knowledge and skills for the recognition, credential, or license required for professional practice. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 8. This is an exact match of ProfessionalDoctorate in [CTDL-TERMS].

Credential awarded upon demonstration through apprenticeship of the highest level of skills and performance in industry trades and professions. This is an exact match of MasterCertificate in [CTDL-TERMS].

Credential awarded for a graduate level course of study where course work and activities advance skills beyond those of the bachelor's degree or its equivalent. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 7. This is an exact match of MasterDegree in [CTDL-TERMS].

Credential that addresses a subset of field-specific knowledge, skills, or competencies; often developmental with relationships to other micro-credentials and field credentials. This is an exact match of MicroCredential in [CTDL-TERMS].

Doctoral degree conferred for advanced work beyond the master level, including the preparation and defense of a thesis or dissertation based on original research, or the planning and execution of an original project demonstrating substantial artistic or scholarly achievement. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011, Level 8. This is an exact match of ResearchDoctorate in [CTDL-TERMS].

Diploma awarded by secondary education institutions for successful completion of a secondary school program of study. Equivalent to an award at UNESCO ISCED 2011 Levels 2 or 3. This is an exact match of SecondarySchoolDiploma in [CTDL-TERMS].

achievementType.description: The type of achievement. This is an extensible vocabulary.

alignment.description: The alignment(s) between this achievement and a node in an external framework. References Alignment.

creator.description: The Profile that created this achievement.

creditsAvailable.description: Credit hours associated with this entity, or credit hours possible. For example 3.0.

criteria.description: Criteria describing how to earn the achievement. References Criteria.

endorsement.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the achievement. References EndorsementCredential.

endorsementJwt.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the achievement in compact JWT format.

fieldOfStudy.description: Category, subject, area of study, discipline, or general branch of knowledge. Examples include Business, Education, Psychology, and Technology.

otherIdentifier.description: A list of identifiers for the described entity. References IdentifierEntry.

related.description: Related achievements, potentially in other languages or different versions of the same achievement.

resultDescription.description: The set of result descriptions that may be asserted when this achievement is awarded. References ResultDescription.

specialization.description: Name given to the focus, concentration, or specific area of study defined in the achievement.

tag.description: One or more short phrases or keywords that describe the achievement.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Achievement.

@context.description: The JSON-LD context(s) that apply to this credential.

awardedDate.description: Timestamp of when the credential was awarded, distinct from validFrom.

credentialSchema.description: One or more data schemas that provide verifiers with enough information to determine whether the provided data conforms to the schema(s).

credentialStatus.description: Information used to discover the current status of the credential (e.g. suspended or revoked).

credentialSubject.description: The recipient of the achievement and their result. References AchievementSubject.

description.description: A short description of the credential.

endorsement.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the credential. References EndorsementCredential.

endorsementJwt.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the credential in compact JWT format.

evidence.description: A description of the work that the recipient did to earn the achievement. This can be a page that links out to other pages if linking directly to the work is infeasible.

image.description: The image representing the credential for display purposes in wallets.

issuer.description: The Profile who is issuing the credential.

proof.description: If present, one or more embedded cryptographic proofs that can be used to detect tampering and verify the authorship of the credential.

refreshService.description: Information used to refresh the verifiable credential.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use issued by the issuer.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be AchievementCredential.

validFrom.description: Timestamp of when the credential becomes valid. VC 2.0 naming (replaces the VC-1.1-era issuanceDate, which does not exist in the current OB3/CLR schema).

validUntil.description: Timestamp after which the credential should no longer be considered valid. VC 2.0 naming (replaces the VC-1.1-era expirationDate, which does not exist in the current OB3/CLR schema).

achievement.description: The achievement being asserted -- the class's whole point. References Achievement.

identifier.description: Other identifiers for the recipient of the achievement. Either id or at least one identifier MUST be supplied.

image.description: An image representing this individual achievement, used instead of the Achievement.image when needed.

licenseNumber.description: The license number that was issued with this credential.

narrative.description: A narrative that describes the achievement or its context.

result.description: The set of results being asserted.

role.description: Role, position, or title of the learner when demonstrating the achievement.

source.description: The person, organization, or system that assessed the learner's achievement. References Profile.

term.description: The academic term in which this assertion was achieved.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be AchievementSubject.

addressCountry.description: The country. For example, USA. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

addressCountryCode.description: A country code as defined in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

addressLocality.description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

geo.description: The geographic coordinates of the location. References GeoCoordinates.

postOfficeBoxNumber.description: The post office box number for PO box addresses.

streetAddress.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Address.

targetCode.description: If applicable, a locally unique string identifier that identifies the alignment target within its framework and/or targetUrl.

targetFramework.description: Name of the framework the alignment target belongs to.

ValueSet.Description: The type of the alignment target node in the target framework. Extensible vocabulary: the fixed tokens below, or a string matching the pattern (ext:)[a-zA-Z0-9\.\-_]+.
ValueSet.Name: AlignmentTargetTypeEnum

Values.Description: An alignment to a CASE Framework Item.
An alignment to a CASE Framework Rubric.
An alignment to a CASE Framework Rubric Criterion.
An alignment to a CASE Framework Rubric Criterion Level.
An alignment to a Credential Engine Item.
An alignment to a CTDL-ASN/CTDL competency published by Credential Engine.
An alignment to a CTDL Credential published by Credential Engine.

targetType.description: The type of the alignment target node. Extensible vocabulary (ext: prefix pattern).

targetUrl.description: The URL of a node in an established educational framework. When the alignment is to a CASE framework and the CASE Service support the CASE JSON-LD binding, the URL should be the 'uri' of the node document, otherwise the URL should be the CASE Service endpoint URL that returns the node JSON.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Alignment.

ValueSet.Description: The type of relationship between two achievements/credentials in an Association. A closed enumeration -- confirmed directly against the CLR v2.0 schema, no ext: extension pattern (unlike CASE's associationType or this model's achievementType/targetType).
ValueSet.Name: AssociationTypeEnum

associationType.description: The type of relationship between the two referenced achievements/credentials.

sourceId.description: The identifier (xsd:anyURI) of the achievement/credential this association originates from.

targetId.description: The identifier (xsd:anyURI) of the achievement/credential this association points to.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Association.

@context.description: The JSON-LD context(s) that apply to this credential, enabling a compact, ontologically defined JSON-LD document.

awardedDate.description: Timestamp of when the credential was awarded. Distinct from validFrom -- an achievement can be awarded before the credential officially becomes valid.

credentialSchema.description: The value of the credentialSchema property MUST be one or more data schemas that provide verifiers with enough information to determine whether the provided data conforms to the provided schema(s).

credentialStatus.description: The information in credentialStatus is used to discover information about the current status of the credential, such as whether it is suspended or revoked.

credentialSubject.description: The learner and their achievements/credentials/associations. References ClrSubject.

description.description: The short description of the credential.

endorsement.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the credential. References EndorsementCredential.

endorsementJwt.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the credential in the form of a verifiable credential in compact JWT format.

evidence.description: A description of the work that the recipient did to earn the achievement. References Evidence.

issuer.description: The Profile who is issuing the credential.

partial.description: Flags an incomplete/in-progress CLR. The one attribute genuinely unique to ClrCredential (vs the shared VC envelope shape with AchievementCredential/EndorsementCredential).

proof.description: A JSON-LD Linked Data proof section for the credential.

refreshService.description: The information in refreshService is used to refresh the verifiable credential.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use issued by the issuer.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be ClrCredential.

validFrom.description: Timestamp of when the credential becomes valid. VC 2.0 naming (replaces the VC-1.1-era issuanceDate).

validUntil.description: Timestamp after which the credential should no longer be considered valid. VC 2.0 naming (replaces the VC-1.1-era expirationDate).

achievement.description: Bare Achievement definitions referenced by this learner's record. References Achievement.

association.description: The relationships between this learner's achievements/credentials. References Association.

identifier.description: One or more identity objects used to identify the learner. References IdentityObject.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be ClrSubject.

verifiableCredential.description: The learner's nested credentials (AchievementCredential and/or EndorsementCredential objects).

id.description: The URI identifying the schema file.

type.description: The type of data schema validation, e.g. 1EdTechJsonSchemaValidator2019.

id.description: The URL of the issuers credential status method.

type.description: The name of the credential status method.

narrative.description: The URI of a webpage that describes in a human-readable format the criteria for the achievement.

@context.description: The JSON-LD context(s) that apply to this credential.

awardedDate.description: Timestamp of when the endorsement was made.

credentialSchema.description: One or more data schemas that provide verifiers with enough information to determine whether the provided data conforms to the schema(s).

credentialStatus.description: Information used to discover the current status of the credential (e.g. suspended or revoked).

credentialSubject.description: The entity being endorsed and the endorsement comment. References EndorsementSubject.

description.description: A short description of the credential.

evidence.description: A description of the work backing this endorsement.

issuer.description: The Profile who is issuing the endorsement.

proof.description: A JSON-LD Linked Data proof section for the credential.

refreshService.description: Information used to refresh the verifiable credential.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use issued by the issuer.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be EndorsementCredential.

validFrom.description: Timestamp of when the credential becomes valid.

validUntil.description: Timestamp after which the credential should no longer be considered valid.

endorsementComment.description: Allows the endorser to make a simple claim in support of the entity being endorsed.

id.description: Unambiguous reference to the thing being endorsed.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be EndorsementSubject.

audience.description: Description of the intended audience for a piece of evidence.

description.description: A longer description of the evidence.

genre.description: A category or classification of the evidence.

id.description: The URL of a webpage presenting evidence of achievement or the evidence encoded as a Data URI. The schema of the webpage is undefined.

name.description: A descriptive title of the evidence.

narrative.description: A narrative that describes the evidence and its relevance to the achievement.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the items MUST be the IRI 'Evidence'.
The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be GeoCoordinates.

identifier.description: The identifier value, in plain text.

ValueSet.Name: IdentifierTypeEnum

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be IdentifierEntry.

hashed.description: Whether the identityHash value is hashed.

identityHash.description: Either the hash of the identity value or the plaintext value, depending on the value of hashed.

ValueSet.Description: Shared enumeration for IdentifierEntry.identifierType and IdentityObject.identityType (confirmed via the schema's own "Origin: IdentifierTypeEnum" comment). Extensible via an ext: prefix pattern.
ValueSet.Name: IdentifierTypeEnum

identityType.description: The type of identity. Shares its enumeration with IdentifierEntry.identifierType.

salt.description: If the identityHash is hashed, this should contain the string used to salt the hash.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be IdentityObject.
The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Image.

additionalName.description: Additional name. Includes what is often referred to as middle name in the western world.

address.description: The address for the individual or organization. References Address.

description.description: A short description of the individual or organization

email.description: A contact email address for the individual or organization.

endorsement.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the Profile. References EndorsementCredential.

endorsementJwt.description: Allows endorsers to make specific claims about the Profile in compact JWT format.

familyName.description: Family name. In the western world, often referred to as the last name of a person.

familyNamePrefix.description: Family name prefix, as used in some locales.

givenName.description: Given name. In the western world, often referred to as the first name of a person.

honorificPrefix.description: Honorific prefix(es) preceding a person's name (e.g. Dr, Mrs, Mr).

honorificSuffix.description: Honorific suffix(es) following a person's name (e.g. M.D, PhD, MSCSE).

id.description: An institution's student identifier for the person, learner, publisher, issuer.

image.description: An image representing the profile, such as a logo.

official.description: If the entity is an organization, official is the name of an authorized official of the organization.

otherIdentifier.description: A list of identifiers for the described entity. References IdentifierEntry.

parentOrg.description: The parent organization of the entity. References Profile.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Profile.

url.description: The homepage or social media profile of the entity, whether individual or institutional.

challenge.description: A value chosen by the verifier to mitigate authentication proof replay attacks.

cryptosuite.description: The suite used to create the proof.

domain.description: The domain of the proof to restrict its use to a particular target.

nonce.description: A value chosen by the creator of proof to randomize proof values for privacy purposes.

proofPurpose.description: The purpose of the proof to be used with verificationMethod. MUST be assertionMethod.

type.description: Signature suite used to produce proof.

verificationMethod.description: The URL of the public key that can verify the signature.

id.description: The URL of the issuers refresh service.

type.description: The name of the refresh service method.

achievedLevel.description: The rubric criterion level achieved. References RubricCriterionLevel's identifier.

alignment.description: The alignment(s) between this result and a node in an external framework. References Alignment.

resultDescription.description: The ResultDescription that this Result is an instance of.

status.description: The status of the achievement. Not yet wired to an enumeration -- see the deferred value-set decision for this data model.

type.description: The value of the type property MUST be an unordered set. One of the values MUST be Result.

value.description: A performance value, such as a score, percent, or raw score.

alignment.description: The alignment(s) between this result description and a node in an external framework.

allowedValue.description: An ordered list of allowed values, from lowest to highest.

requiredLevel.description: The id of the rubric criterion level required to pass, as determined by the achievement creator.

requiredValue.description: The value that must be met or exceeded to pass, when resultType is one of the numeric or level types.

valueMax.description: The maximum value allowed for this result.

valueMin.description: The minimum value allowed for this result.

level.description: The level in terms of interpreted meaning, not the point value.

points.description: The points associated with this level.
